content:
A small number of iPhone 18 Pro users have reported that the speaker occasionally makes a "pop" or "click" sound, describing faint glitches when switching apps and performing other operations……

MacRumors found related posts on its discussion forum and the Reddit platform. The number is enough to confirm the issue exists, but it also reflects that the situation is not widespread.

Looking at the variables involved in the various reports, no consistent pattern has been identified so far; some believe the issue may stem from software rather than hardware. The unit I use has not shown this problem.
